args.title: Corvid returns research — combined summary (main + subscriber companion)
args.body:
- Apparel return rates have reached 24%, making returns a first-order cost problem in retail logistics.
- Consolidating return hubs cut handling cost by roughly a fifth (~20%).
- Resale of returned goods within 10 days preserved most of the margin, per the subscriber companion piece.

Sources: https://blog.corvid.example/2026/returns and https://insights.corvid.example/returns/companion (accessed via team subscription code SUB-1337).
